page.layout: One printed page: the e-rara.ch digitiser's cover sheet, with logo at top right, title block centred, a rule, then notice paragraphs and terms of use, and the Visual Library logo at bottom right. Nothing here is part of the early modern book, so the page is left empty.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not printed text of the 1676 book. Omitted per the rules: the e-rara.ch logo and banner, the title block (www.e-rara.ch, title "Disputationis theologicae pars prior, de clavibus regni Dei, apostolis traditis", author Gyöngyösi, István, Tiguri Helvetiorum, anno 1676, Zentralbibliothek Zürich, Shelf Mark 6.88,17, persistent link), the multilingual usage notice, and the Visual Library logo.
